text: On the eve of Antonio Bay's centennial, a glowing fog rolls in from the sea carrying [the drowned crew of the Elizabeth Dane|threat|the restless dead]. A hundred years ago the town's six founders [wrecked the ship to keep its leprous owner away|wrong|the outsider punished] and built the town on its gold, a secret Father Malone finds in [his grandfather's hidden diary|wrong|sins of the ancestors]. From her lighthouse, radio DJ Stevie Wayne watches the fog swallow the streets and begs listeners to save her son, while the revenants [come for six lives|wants|revenge for a wrong].
